faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for ANH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 3 December 2026, and candidates report at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ANH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies for Junior Resident (MBBS).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ANH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 3 December 2026 at 10:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Chamber of Head of Office, 4th Floor, Ambedkar Nagar Hospital, B-Block, Sector-5, Dakshinpuri, Delhi.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 30 years for General candidates, 35 years for SC/ST candidates and 33 years for OBC candidates (on the date of interview). Relaxation: OBC 33 years, SC/ST 35 years, Persons with disabilities Upper age limit relaxable by 10 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Basic pay in Level-10 as per 7th Pay Commission.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS Degree recognized by MCI; registered with Delhi Medical Council; must not have completed one year Junior Residency; candidates who completed internship more than two years from the date of advertisement are not eligible.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be registered with Delhi Medical Council.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who have completed one year Junior Residency. Candidates who have completed internship beyond/more than two years from the date of Advertisement.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview. Decision of the Selection Board/Medical Director, AN Hospital regarding selection is final and binding.
